tier_reason: Raised C to B: the enricher reached an independent measurement by Aras Pranckevicius (December 2020 texture compression post; source and chart data in aras-p/aras-p.hugo at content/blog/2020/12-texcompr.md and static/img/blog/2020/texcompr/chart-bc7.html, read via raw.githubusercontent.com) on 20 images, Intel Core i9 2.9 GHz MacBook Pro 2018, clang 11.0.3, ISPC 1.14, AVX2: against ispc_texcomp's same-name profiles bc7e is 3.0x faster at fast, 4.0x at basic and 10.1x at slow, at 0.7-1.1 dB higher PSNR, while ultrafast is 0.88x (slower). Independent and numeric with compiler and CPU named; not A because the benchmark harness itself is not published with build flags. Caveat: the timed bc7e.ispc has the SIMD-width-dependent all() early-out in estimate_partition_list (issue #2, fixed only in bc7enc_rdo), a small quality effect that does not void the ratio; and Traverse-Research/intel-tex-rs-2 PR #50 (2026-09-28) makes ispc_texcomp BC7 2.1-6.2x faster, so the ratios hold against upstream ispc_texcomp only.

corrections.claimed_speedup: Independent measurement (Aras Pranckevicius, Dec 2020, 20 images, Core i9 2.9 GHz MacBook Pro 2018, clang 11.0.3, ISPC 1.14, AVX2), same-name profiles against ispc_texcomp: fast 3.0x, basic 4.0x, slow 10.1x faster at 0.7-1.1 dB higher PSNR; ultrafast 0.88x (slower) (derived from chart data). README says 'usually around 2-3x faster vs. ispc_texcomp at the same average quality ... up to ~8x faster vs. ispc_texcomp's slow profile'.
corrections.hardware: Intel Core i9 2.9 GHz, MacBook Pro 2018 (Aras Pranckevicius run); AVX2
corrections.compiler_and_flags: clang 11.0.3, ISPC 1.14, AVX2 target (Aras Pranckevicius run); optimisation flags not stated
corrections.caveats: Mixed at the fastest setting: ultrafast is 0.88x of ispc_texcomp. The timed bc7e.ispc carries the SIMD-width-dependent all() early-out (issue #2; fixed only in bc7enc_rdo via BC7E_NON_DETERMINISTIC 0). ispc_texcomp has since been sped up 2.1-6.2x in Traverse-Research/intel-tex-rs-2 (PR #50, 2026-09-28), so the ratios hold against upstream Intel ispc_texcomp only. Repository archived.
